description: Ministry of Industry and Commerce - Authorizing the Purpose for "Sanastha Lanka Ayurveda Shasthree Waidya Sansadaya" as a purpose to which the Powers and facilities of the Societies Ordinance, be extented
reasoning: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize a society's purpose and limit the application of the ordinance to that society. It deals with regulatory matters and legal provisions (Sections 3, 4, and 5(4) of the Ordinance), making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory action being taken, not a personnel appointment or portfolio description.
